reasons: This page is directly connected to a confirmed threat (fees@okaxis).
The login form sends credentials to collect.badhost.example, which Northstar University does not use.
The page claims to be Northstar University but apply.northstar-admissions.example is not one of its verified domains.
The payment address fees@okaxis is not one registered by Northstar University (registered: fees@northstar-demo).
The page shows a logo that closely matches Northstar University's logo.

findings.title: Connected to a confirmed threat
findings.detail: This page sends data to fees@okaxis, which is part of a confirmed threat.

findings.title: Domain is not registered by the organisation
findings.detail: The page claims to be Northstar University, but apply.northstar-admissions.example is not one of its verified domains.

findings.title: Logo closely matches the organisation's logo
findings.detail: The page logo is 2/64 bits from Northstar University's registered logo.

findings.title: Credentials go somewhere the organisation does not use
findings.detail: The login form sends credentials to collect.badhost.example; Northstar University uses northstar-demo.example, login.northstar-demo.example.

findings.title: Payment address is not registered by the organisation
findings.detail: The page asks for a transfer to fees@okaxis; Northstar University has registered fees@northstar-demo.

findings.title: Shares infrastructure with a reported threat
findings.detail: apply.northstar-admissions.example shares nameservers ns1.badhost.example, ns2.badhost.example, hosting range 203.0.113.0/24 with a reported site.
